explication: This repository is a collection of Office Add-in samples. The clearest runtime workflow is Excel invoking a custom function, which either computes locally, queues a batched operation, or POSTs to an Azure Function before returning a value to Excel. A separate Web Worker demonstrates message-based synchronous and promise-based computation. MVC templates provide host-specific controller entry points for Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word. The README describes many additional samples, but those directories are not present in the supplied tree, so they are not expanded here.
